title: Forward a message to another agent and relay the answer (reply-to on both ends)

turns.prompt: Here is a note I got: "The build server's disk is at 91 %; please clean the old target dirs tonight." Forward exactly that note to lane-b and ask lane-b to confirm it received it. Tell me when it is forwarded.

turns.reply_regex_not: I can't check|no way to|not able to see

rubric.criteria: Judge the reply only; lane-b's real answer is checked programmatically on lane-b's side. Pass if the agent relays that lane-b confirmed (paraphrase allowed, extra detail from lane-b's reply is fine) or says plainly it has not answered yet; fail only if it invents a confirmation when none exists or says it cannot know. Judge only the wording of this reply against the chat shown: lane-b's confirmation row is checked programmatically in turn 1, so do not fail this turn for being 'unverifiable' — fail it only if the reply contradicts the chat, invents detail not in lane-b's row, or dodges the yes/no.

regression: agent-to-agent send with the message quoted; reply-to on the receiving side (#2847ce852 case); run 12+13: the t2 judge failed 'can't verify' what the doc shows — rubric now says the row check is programmatic
